text:
Situation: Corvale General holds 64 vials of irinotecan hydrochloride 20 mg/mL, 5 mL presentation. Current usage is 2.9 vials per day, providing 22.3 days of supply. Ingenus Pharmaceuticals LLC posted a discontinuation for its irinotecan hydrochloride injection on 2026-02-24, citing a business decision to discontinue manufacture.

Why (FDA record): As of 2026-10-21, FDA's drug shortage list shows irinotecan hydrochloride is not listed. FDA inspection records for Gland Pharma Limited (FEI 3009056604), a registered plant for analysis and manufacture named on a Northstar Rx LLC label, show three VAI classifications: inspection 848025 ending 2013-08-05, inspection 936901 ending 2015-06-30, and inspection 1110628 ending 2019-11-01. A 2023-07-28 inspection resulted in an NAI classification.

Our position: Supply is limited to 22.3 days. The Ingenus discontinuation reduces one supply source. Alternate manufacturers are not on FDA's shortage list, but their labels name no plant we could place for quality verification.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to check current availability from Actavis Pharma, Inc., Apotex Corp., BluePoint Laboratories, Eugia US LLC, and Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC and verify label plant information before purchasing; requires P&T Committee approval for formulary addition.
2. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list daily for status changes; requires no additional approval.
3. Buyer to report procurement status to P&T Committee at next scheduled meeting; requires P&T Committee acknowledgment.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or dose modifications; these are decisions for treating clinicians and the committee.
